Class NoTrailers

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.body.stream.NoTrailers
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConversionServiceProvider, ConvertibleMultiValues<String>, ConvertibleValues<List<String>>, Headers, ValueResolver<CharSequence>, HttpHeaders, Iterable<Map.Entry<String, List<String>>>
@Internal public final class NoTrailers extends Object implements HttpHeaders
The trailers of a body that carries none: an immutable empty HttpHeaders and a stage that is already complete with it.
